CREATE TABLE bioinsights_unsold(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                fid INTEGER(4) NOT NULL,
                id64 INTEGER(8) NOT NULL,
                bodyid INTEGER(4) NOT NULL,
                dtepoch INTEGER(8) NOT NULL,
                bioname TEXT NOT NULL,
                species INTEGER(2) NOT NULL,
                basevalue INTEGER(8) NOT NULL,
                bodyname TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(fid,id64,bodyid,species) ON CONFLICT REPLACE
                )

                bodyid INTEGER(4) NOT NULL,
